The Submissions of the counsel appeari petitioner are even though the petitioners are charge-sheeted, however, the offence ought to have been registered and investigated viz Crime No. I-205 of 2021 punishable under Sections 498A, 406,
323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

It is claimed that even if what has been stated in the complaint is correct for the sake of argument, till the entire offence allegedly have taken place outside the jurisdiction of the Bhadrakali Police Station i.e. in the State of Rajasthan.
2. With the assistance, we have perused the contents in the complaint, there appears to be substance in the submissions of the counsel for the petitioners.
